subject: Request for latest penetration test package and secure transfer options
messages:
From: Alex Burke <alex.burke@finserve.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-02-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: most recent penetration test for Redwood hosted API + transfer method

Hi Marissa,

We're working through FinServe's vendor security intake and need the most recent penetration test report and remediation status for Redwood's hosted API environment. A few details so we can scope the request on our side:

- Please confirm the date of the most recent penetration test that covers the hosted/redwoodapi service.
- Does the report include the multi-tenant hosted runtime only, or does it also cover Dedicated/Private deployment options?
- We need an executive summary (PDF) and a remediation tracker; we do not require raw logs.
- Preferred secure transfer methods for us: presigned S3 link (7-day expiry), secure SFTP dropbox, or a vendor evidence portal with one-time login.
- We will need redaction of provider account IDs and internal IP addresses.

We can sign an NDA if needed. Point of contact for follow-ups: Alice Burke (alice.burke@finserve.com), Security Manager.

Thanks,
Alex Burke
Security Intake
FinServe Financial
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Burke <alex.burke@finserve.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: most recent penetration test for Redwood hosted API + transfer method

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We're happy to help. Summary below so you can confirm the exact package you want delivered: 

What we have:
- Most recent full penetration test run date: 2025-12-10.
- Coverage: hosted API (multi-tenant control plane + inference runtime used by our hosted customers). The test did NOT include customer-managed Dedicated or Private deployments (those are excluded unless explicitly commissioned).
- Deliverables we can provide:
  - redwood_pt_execsummary_20251210.pdf (executive summary, low-risk/high-level findings)
  - remediation_status_20260218.csv (row-level remediation status per finding)
  - redwood_pt_package_20251210.zip (full test package; we redact account IDs/IPs by default and can provide a redacted version if needed)

Secure transfer options (choose one):
1) Presigned S3 link (recommended) — we can create objects that expire in 7 days and rotate presign keys.
2) SFTP dropbox — we can upload password-encrypted ZIP and share SFTP creds; key shared over phone/secure channel.
3) One-time evidence portal link — temporary account + forced MFA for reviewers.

Redaction & scope notes: by default we redact internal AWS account IDs, internal IPs, and any customer-identifying artifacts. If you need less redaction (e.g., for internal audit), we can discuss an NDAd/attestation workflow and a scoped view.

Next steps: please confirm which transfer option you prefer and whether you only want the executive summary + remediation CSV or the full package. If presigned S3, confirm that a 7-day expiry is acceptable and we will proceed to generate the link.

I'm CC'ing Ben (security engineering) for any technical follow-ups and Karthik (legal/compliance) for redaction/attestation questions.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance & Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: none in this thread yet (will prepare once you confirm option).

Marissa — thanks. Presigned S3 link with a 7-day expiry works best for us. A few clarifications: 

- We only need the executive summary PDF and the remediation tracker CSV (no full package).
- Please redact AWS account IDs and private IPs; leaving public endpoint names or customer-agnostic hostnames is fine.
- For the remediation tracker, can you include the current remediation owner and an estimated completion date for open items?
- Our internal reviewer list: Alice Burke (alice.burke@finserve.com) and Tom Nguyen (tom.nguyen@finserve.com).

If you could send the presigned link and a short download instruction (and contact for the CSIRT if we have follow-ups), that would be great.

Thanks,
